de.abas.ceks.jedp.query

Interface EDPQueryResultFieldSet

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    EDPQuery, EDPQueryResult

    public interface EDPQueryResultFieldSet
    Set of fields for a query result. Such a set could be a set of header fields or a set of table fields for a certain row.
    Author:
    xg

    • Method Summary

      Modifier and Type Method and Description

      Provides the number of fields in the current record.

      Provides the values of all fields of the current record in one string array.

    • Method Detail

      • getFieldCount

        int getFieldCount()
        Provides the number of fields in the current record. This only makes sense after positioning on an existing record.
        Returns:
        Anzahl Felder im aktuellen Datensatz
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • getFields

        String[] getFields()
        Provides the values of all fields of the current record in one string array.
        Returns:
        string array containing all field values of the current record
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • getFieldsAsList

        List<String> getFieldsAsList()
        Provides the values of all fields of the current record as a list
        Returns:
        list of strings containing all field values of the current record
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • getField

        String getField(int fieldNumber)
        Provides the value of a field in the current record using its position in the field list.
        Parameters:
        fieldNumber - number of field to retrieve (beginning with 1 for the first field)
        Returns:
        field value as string
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • getField

        String getField(String fieldName)
        Provides the value of a field in the current record using its name. This method only works if the originating query has been started with a string array or FieldList as field list argument or if query meta data were enabled.
        Parameters:
        fieldName - name of the field to retrieve
        Returns:
        field value or null if the field list does not contain this field
        Since:
        abas Version 10, EDP Version 2.0

      • getMetaData

        EDPQueryMetaData getMetaData()
        Provides the meta data object for the query result, if meta data were enabled.
        Returns:
        meta data object for the query result or null if meta data weren't enabled.
        Since:
        abas Version 2008r3, EDP Version 3.24
        See Also:
        EDPQuery.enableQueryMetaData(boolean)
